facts.text: I came to a wedding, and now I'm stacking shelves. At least the snacks are free.
facts.why: Keung never says this and does not stack shelves. He stops the bikers outside, then fights them in and around Elaine's supermarket.
facts.fix: I came for a wedding, and now I'm fighting bikers in the aisles. Please keep my receipt.

fix_note.text: I came for a wedding, and now I'm fighting bikers in the aisles. Please keep my receipt.

facts.text: Serve the mains at his uncle's wedding banquet.
facts.why: The wedding is set for the afternoon at the supermarket and is shown as a party, but no banquet or meal is mentioned.
facts.fix: Serve the mains at his uncle's wedding party.

facts.why: Same as the cue: the wedding is shown but no banquet is.

facts.text: For Danny, Nancy's little brother, who keeps an eye on the store
facts.why: Danny is Nancy's paraplegic brother and Keung's friend, and the diamonds are hidden in his wheelchair cushion. Nobody has him minding a store.
facts.fix: For Danny, Nancy's little brother, who sits on the diamonds

Six-foot sword on the Lamborghini sweeping the hovercraft
Diamonds hidden in Danny's wheelchair cushion
